title: Punktlandung Team Context
description: Reusable team/organization context (roles, colors, platform guards, constraints) shared across multiple plan.md or feature-set specifications.

lang.description: UI language of the compiled HTML overview.

org.description: Team or organization label shown as default subtitle.

assignmentNote.description: Banner text explaining whether RACI assignments are proposed or fixed.

constraints.description: Standing environment constraints (e.g., AI implements after release).

principles.description: Ordered decision hierarchy (index 0 wins on collision, e.g. Legal > Data > Sourcing).

defaultRule.description: Standing burden-of-proof / fallback rule when uncertainty cannot be resolved.

contact.description: Optional named contact(s) for this party (omitted in anonymised copies).

consultWhen.description: Trigger condition when this party must be consulted (C) or given mandate (A), e.g. personal data or employee monitoring.

isPlatform.description: If true, validator forbids assigning A or R to this party.
